recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format composition featuring a high-contrast, high-key photograph of a man in formal 1970s attire leaning against a luxury car, framed by a thick cream-colored border with heavy, rounded display typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a thick, uniform off-white border.
Typography placed strictly within the top margin of the border.
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows against a bright, blown-out background.
Text color mirroring the dark tones of the subject's hair and the car.
coreInvariants: Heavyweight, rounded sans-serif display type with thick outlines.
High-key photographic style with saturated mid-tones.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait of a man, centered, occupying approximately 70% of the inner frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark hair, providing a focal point against the bright background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the heavy top text, move down to the subject's face, follow the lean of the body to the car, and end at the bottom-left corner logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the thick outer border and the blown-out white areas of the background house.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) overall with localized areas of high saturation and deep black shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters.
Heavy black outline surrounding white or light-filled glyphs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning where letters almost touch.
Uniform cap height across all words.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face for the main title, with a small, contrasting script or serif for secondary branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, heavy 70s geometric aesthetic.
Matches the thick, rounded, low-counter construction.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key photograph of a man in a tan 70s suit with a ruffled peach shirt, leaning against a dark vintage luxury car in front of a white house. Surround the image with a thick cream-colored square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two phrases in the top cream border using an ultra-bold rounded sans-serif font with a thick black outline and white fill. Add a small red script logo in the bottom-left corner of the border.

verificationChecks: Is the border thick and cream-colored?
Is the typography ultra-bold with rounded edges and a thick outline?
Is the photo high-contrast with blown-out highlights?
Is the text placed exclusively in the top margin?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific brand names in the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the inner image.
Check that the cream border is uniform on all four sides.
Verify the 'halo' effect of the thick black outline on the text.
Confirm the subject's attire reflects 1970s formal fashion.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square high-key portrait + Thick cream border + Heavy rounded outlined display type in top margin.
